 Missing Angoon fisherman found dead
 October 28, 2026 by Clarise Larson, KTOO 
 Share: Angoon on Sunday, Oct. 27, 2024. (Photo by Clarise Larson/KTOO) 
 Update, Wednesday 4:30 p.m.:
 Roger Williams, Jr. was found dead Wednesday, according to Troopers.
 Angoon Search and Rescue located his body on the shore near Danger Reef Point shortly before 1 p.m. His remains are being transported to the State Medical Examiner’s office.
 Williams’s next of kin have been notified.
 Original story:
 A community-wide search and rescue is underway in Angoon for a man who hasn’t been seen since he left to go fishing Tuesday morning.  
 Angoon is a Southeast Alaska community on Admiralty Island near Juneau. According to Alaska State Troopers, 35-year-old Roger Williams, Jr. was reportedly last known to be taking his red and silver 16-foot Lund boat from the Angoon boat harbor to the ferry terminal to go cockle fishing.  
 He was last seen at about 8:30 a.m. Tuesday wearing a brown Carhartt jacket, black pants, and boots. 
 Troopers say at about 8 p.m., the U.S. Coast Guard discovered an unoccupied 16-foot Lund skiff near the shoreline between Killisnoo Island and Angoon.  
 The Coast Guard is continuing to search for Williams via helicopter, and a communitywide search is also underway. Wrangell search and rescue teams are also assisting in the search.  
 This story has been updated.
